name: block-watcher
description: Always-on Cloud Run SERVICE (not a Job, unlike sweeper/consolidator - holds persistent WebSocket connections) that independently detects crypto deposits by scanning chains directly, genuinely redundant with (not a fallback to) the Tatum/Alchemy webhooks. Deliberately a separate deployable from apps/api - its own image, its own service account, its own IAM. Never imported by or bundled into apps/api; posts detections to apps/api's /webhooks/block-watcher instead. See docs/planning-history.md's Strategy 3 section.
